notes: Croatian is finished. B1, lessons 174 to 344, gets the same pass A0, A1 and A2 already had, and the whole course now ends every lesson with a wrap-up that asks for one clear thing you can actually type. Two things were badly wrong at this level. The wrap-up refused any answer longer than 40 characters, which is fine for A0 words but throws away almost everything B1 teaches: 88 of 171 lessons had quietly stopped testing you and were replaying their exercise instead. And the exam-prep lessons had their study checklists stored as Croatian content, so the app was asking you to type your own revision notes back from memory. Sentences are now accepted, and graded without punishing a missing accent the way a single word still does. 387 titles are in English. All four levels are now held by the build gates, so none of this can come back.
